summary: Pope County steel lookout, 100 feet tall, on the Shawnee: site materials bought in 1936, photographed 1941, now listed as gone.

facts.status_note: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks the tower as gone; these sources give no removal date and no description of the site.

events.note: In April 1936 purchase of materials was started for a dwelling, garage-woodshed, cistern and latrine at the Raum tower site, on the same list as the Deputy and Honey School sites.
National Archives photograph 'Photograph of Raum Lookout' is dated June 1941, so the tower was standing by then.
A listing from about 1942 calls it the Raum Lookout Station, U.S. Forest Service, a 100-foot steel tower; visitors welcome.

notes_for_editor: Record checks: county, agency and the 30.5 m height agree with the about-1942 listing (100 feet). The record's 231.9 m elevation was not checked against a source page; a search result from another site gave 764 ft, about 232.9 m, so verify before using it. No source gives a build date, a removal date or a description of the site, so no built or removed event. Staffing is not stated, so no staffing key. Access is omitted because no source gives a public or closed status. The photo in the record is the same NARA image (2129090) and is not a new find.
